scope: Five approved flat tinted glasses, 4 mm
method: Visual comparison with live catalogue renders and archived glass sample. These are visual references, not measured spectral data. Tinted mirror archives excluded.

matte.note: Satin blur and visual colours from catalogue renders; not measured scattering or spectral data.

stopsol.note: Live sample renders: neutral, bronze and grey reflective glass. Coating is an artistic metalness/transmission approximation, not measured reflectance.

raywallApproval.scope: Structure and blur of Raywall 90T in the local facade configurator; do not retune without owner request. Not approval of other ribbed materials.
raywallApproval.note: Illustrative inspection mode, not measured optical properties. Preserve contact-zone visibility and glare-free appearance.

moruFlutesPitch.scope: All ribbed MORU and Flutes; excludes flat tinted and flat matte materials with legacy MORU slugs

ultraApproval.scope: Rounded structure and blur accepted for MORU ULTRA; other family optical presets awaiting review

colourRevision.ownerInstruction: Swap Bronze/Grey mass tint with corresponding magnetron variant tones; make both magnetron variants maximally reflective.
colourRevision.mode: Strong studio environment reflection on coated variants only; mass-tinted variants remain transmissive. Approximate optical preview.

estriado.reference: Owner confirmed 37–38 ribs / 100 mm and supplied front and edge photos of ordinary Estriado. Fine nearly triangular relief, flat reverse. Same approved pattern for all three variants.
estriado.limits: Pitch is representative of confirmed range, not exact factory measurement. Relief slope and optical tints are visual approximations; Crystal and Ultra use earlier approved sample renders.

visionSun.method: Owner confirmed 20 ribs per 100 mm on 2026-10-20. Supersedes photo estimate of 5.75 mm.
visionSun.appearance: Physical sample photo provided by owner supersedes wardrobe render: rounded vertical ribs, visible coloured object fragments, low haze rather than uniform frosted blur. Pitch 5 mm retained. Optical strengths approximate; 5 mm sample photo informs appearance only, facade glass remains 4 mm.

fluteliteS.source: Owner confirmed count and supplied four physical sample photos viewed against dark background and coloured object.
fluteliteS.appearance: Fine vertical ribs, green edge, coloured objects visible in narrow displaced strips. No uniform frosted veil. Contacting profile stays sharp.
fluteliteS.limits: Representative midpoint of confirmed count range. Relief cross section, absorption and roughness visually approximated, not measured.

krezet.reference: Previously approved product sample and facade renders, four planar facets per square cell.
krezet.limits: Existing prototype/older facade scale 2 mm retained provisionally; old spec also lists 2.3 mm. Not owner-confirmed measurement. Relief slopes and optical blur approximate.

diamant.reference: Approved transparent variant 2 product render (100 x 150 mm).
diamant.method: Procedural irregular planar facets; transmission rather than metallic opacity. Approximate 4 mm average facet spacing in a 64 mm seamless tile; not a confirmed measured pattern.
diamant.status: First local approximation awaiting owner review.

gothic.reference: Approved variant 1 product render, sample 100 x 150 mm.
gothic.method: Approximate procedural flowing surface with narrow wandering veins and fine unevenness; soft transmission distortion. Pattern dimensions are visual estimates, not measurements.

kathedralKlein.method: Fine flowing uneven relief, soft transparent distortion, procedural approximation; scale and optical strengths not measured.

aqualite.reference: Approved variant 1 of second series, archived product sample.
aqualite.method: Broad flowing waves with fine ripples, approximate procedural optics; dimensions not measured.

krepi.method: Fine shallow uneven relief and soft blur; approximate procedural optics, no measured pitch.

silvit.reference: Owner physical sample photo supplied 2026-10-20 replaces render as primary reference.
silvit.method: Uneven isolated winding veins with variable width, local interruptions and neighbouring fragments. Clear spaces between veins; restrained illustrative contrast without specular glare. Scale approximate, not measured.
silvit.status: Revised local preview awaiting owner review.

atlantic.reference: Archived approved Monumental Atlantic sample v1.
atlantic.method: Irregular larger polygonal regions with differently oriented fine ridges; approximate procedural optics, estimated scale.

hithicross.reference: Archived approved sample variant 3, 100 x 150 mm.
hithicross.method: Rounded square cells with crossed refraction. Approximate 15 mm cell pitch estimated visually, explicitly marked provisional in UI. Processing restrictions unchanged.

dichroic.method: Thin-film reflection plus illustrative view-dependent transmission tint, transparent smooth surface. Not measured spectral optics.

painted.reference: Saved ALFAGLASS catalogue material profiles: 13 lacobel and 10 matelac cards. Owner explicitly selected ALFAGLASS rather than manufacturer catalogue.
painted.method: Approximate RGB colours, opaque glossy Lacobel and rough matte Matelac. Not measured colour samples.
painted.status: Local palette awaiting owner review; light-colour finish contrast needs further tuning.

mirrors.reference: Saved ALFAGLASS silver, Crystalvision and tinted mirror catalogue profiles.
mirrors.method: Actual planar scene reflection multiplied by uniform approximate catalogue tint. Tinted variants retain 25% scene chroma. Previous 12% brightness modulation removed because it obscured reflections. No artificial spatial gradient.
mirrors.back: Owner specification 2026-10-20: opaque matte RAL 7024 backing, approximate screen RGB #474a51; separate back face, no mirror reflection.
